scope: Fixed screen A/B context only. No threshold, score recomputation or performance/correctness verdict.

request_join.common_subset_scope: Both stable keys present, scalar/histogram-valid and error_present=False in both. Does not replace whole-run totals or remove rows from joined CSV.

A.boundary_rule: latest loop row with next-row timestamp <= profiling start; first loop row timestamp >= profiling end

B.boundary_rule: latest loop row with next-row timestamp <= profiling start; first loop row timestamp >= profiling end

A.units: Not embedded in these JSONL rows: preserve original metric field names and numbers; unit interpretation requires installed schema/aggregate metadata. nvidia_memory_used is not raw bytes.
A.scope: Separate AIPerf telemetry series; no merge with independent NVML samples or inferred GPU/rank mapping.

B.units: Not embedded in these JSONL rows: preserve original metric field names and numbers; unit interpretation requires installed schema/aggregate metadata. nvidia_memory_used is not raw bytes.
B.scope: Separate AIPerf telemetry series; no merge with independent NVML samples or inferred GPU/rank mapping.

limits: Counter deltas use preserved outer scrape intervals and include adjacent work; they are not exactly the client cohort.
GPU indices require external physical/rank mapping. Host lifetime-counter levels are descriptive, not activity deltas.
Different finite warmup request counts remain visible; no equal-cache-state claim is inferred.
Any invalid/duplicate stable keys remain in explicit receipt lists and require review; no selective repair.
